title: Reconstruction of a canonical block code
statement: Let $B$ be a switching block code whose bits are zero at every position outside its designated position set. Reconstructing a code from that position set and the restriction of its bits to it gives back $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $B$ is canonical: every bit outside its position set is zero
